summary: Storytel AB (publ) engages in the audiobook and publishing market in Sweden, Denmark, the United States, Finland, the Netherlands, Poland, Iceland, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Streaming and Publishing. The Streaming segment offers audiobooks and e-books streaming services under the Storytel and Mofibo brands, as well as through Audiobooks.com. The Publishing segment provides printed books, audiobooks, and e-books through Norstedts, Rabén & Sjögren, Lind & Co, People's, Gummerus, Bokfabriken, and Storyside publishing houses. Storytel AB (publ) is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
